newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Japanese business executives to visit Israel.
newsitem.headline: Japanese business executives to visit Israel.

text.p: A delegation of senior executives from Japan's leading computer manufacturers will visit Israel next week, the Israeli investment banking and consulting firm that is to host them said on Thursday.
"This is the first time a delegation of this size and seniority from Japan's computer insudstry will be visiting Israel," Shlomo Kalish, head of the firm, Jeruslem Global Ltd, said in a statement.
He said the purpose of the trip was to allow decision-making executives to view Israeli high-tech firms and explore avenues of cooperation.
Companies to be represented in the delegation include NEC, Toshiba, Fujitsu, Hitachi, and Matsushita, Jerusalem Global said.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Industry and Trade Minister Natan Sharansky will also meet with the group.
